newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-INVESTMENT BANK OF LATVIA Q1 ASSETS RISE.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-INVESTMENT BANK OF LATVIA Q1 ASSETS RISE.

text.p: The Investment Bank of Latvia said on Tuesday that its assets grew by 20 percent in the first quarter of the year to 133.9 million lats and its loan portfolio increased by nearly 80 percent to 8.3 million lats.

The bank, part-owned by the state and whose main aim is to channel investments into small and medium-sized companies, said in a statement that operating revenues had doubled and the net profit was 122,409 lats.
It said it continued to focus on investment project finance but there was growing interest in the bank's other products and services.
